lineage.alpha-opportunity-model-v1: first opportunity preregistration; BLOCKED_PREREGISTRATION; never executed
lineage.alpha-opportunity-model-v2: benchmark-as-outside-option redesign; sealed READY; never historically executed; superseded before any outcome by the three defects v3 records
lineage.alpha-opportunity-model-v3: separates expected value from probability and confidence; audits identity and survivorship in both regions; seals only the computed execution closure; BLOCKED_BY_DATA_INTEGRITY
lineage.alpha-opportunity-model-v4: the only version that may become READY_FOR_HISTORICAL_EXECUTION, as a new preregistration over repaired, sealed inputs re-audited with v3's rules; no outcome is read before it is sealed

whyV3.A_hiddenHurdles: v2 required P(net alpha > 0) > 0.5 and bootstrap lower bounds above the outside option for ACTIVE_OPPORTUNITY; expected value can be positive while the probability of beating the benchmark is below one half, and while the fitted-value interval spans zero, so those were hurdles on existence, not the outside-option comparison
whyV3.B_survivorship: v2 treated the US gap as a missingness share under a 20% tolerance and bounded forward endpoints; the input-only audit shows the US sample contains no security that ever terminated and every missing member is a departed one, so no tolerance or endpoint bound addresses it
whyV3.C_closure: v2's dependencyHashes pinned 51 files incl. kelly_portfolio, longterm, replay_valuation, selection_null via lazy imports of portfolio_validation and via regional_alpha_features -> historical_replay; unrelated production edits would strand v2

decisionContract.question: Is E[R_i - R_benchmark(i)] - roundTripCost_i > 0 ?
onlyConditions: the PIT tradability guard carried from v2

probability.meaning: P(R_i - R_b - cost > 0) from the separately fitted Logistic head
probability.notA: median or any quantile of the Ridge head's prediction: the two heads are separate models, not one coherent predictive distribution

fittedValue.source: alpha_opportunity_model.prediction_uncertainty: 200 training-only moving-block refits, 5th/95th percentiles of the refitted prediction

predictive.source: alpha_opportunity_model.matured_residual_scale: equal-date RMS of realised minus predicted over past matured out-of-fold predictions

decisionContract.opportunitySurface: every POSITIVE_EXPECTED_ALPHA name, ordered by expectedNetAlpha for downstream analysis only; zero names is NO_POSITIVE_EXPECTED_ALPHA
decisionContract.portfolioLayer: SEPARATE_AND_UNDEFINED_HERE: risk preference, whether a positive-EV low-win-rate name is taken, confidence weighting, Kelly, inverse volatility, target volatility, dependence and concentration are never part of alpha existence

models.baseline: training date-weighted prevalence / training date-weighted mean relative return
models.interpretation: LINEAR primary and the only family that produces decisions; SHALLOW_CHALLENGER complementary interaction evidence only, never a decision, never a rescue, never a winner

transforms.scaler: date-weighted training median and IQR; zero IQR -> 1
transforms.imputation: training median plus indicators for every active field; allmissing fields omitted per fold and logged

walkForward.refit: first regional weekly signal date each calendar year; expanding history
walkForward.prediction: last regional session each calendar week
walkForward.maturity: outcomeEndDate strictly less than fold cutoff; no label merely started before cutoff
walkForward.embargo: exact endpoint maturity purge; no extra arbitrary embargo; training uses past only
walkForward.missingTrainingLabels: unresolved endpoints are excluded from TRAINING with counts; evaluation bounds them (survivorship)
walkForward.pendingEvaluation: exclude dates whose scheduled exit exceeds data cutoff; purely calendar-based, not label-quality based
walkForward.coverageGate: per-region-year minimum applies to evaluation years 2016 onward; training warmup coverage disclosed; no pre-source KR accounting imputation claim
walkForward.evaluationStart: first READY annual fold of each region x horizon cell; every later scheduled fold must be READY or the cell is DATA_INSUFFICIENT
walkForward.survivorshipEligibility: replaced: a region-year enters training or evaluation only if the region is survivorship-safe under survivorship.rules; v2's reuse of a 20% gap tolerance built for a different gate is withdrawn

targets.beatBenchmarkNet_H: 1 iff forwardRelativeReturn_H > roundTripCost(region, signal date) else 0
targets.entry: next regional exchange session CLOSE after information date
targets.exit: H additional regional exchange sessions after entry
targets.informationTimestamp: end of signal calendar day in regional timezone; date-only filings strictly earlier
targets.totalReturn: replay-v16 forward accumulated distributions/splits, same endpoint basis for stock and benchmark
targets.missingOrDelisted: exact endpoints only; unresolved endpoint => MISSING_FORWARD_PRICE_OR_DELISTING; never zero, forward fill, nearest date or last price
targets.implementation: alpha_opportunity_v2_evaluation.target_from_sessions (v1 target_at semantics, precomputed calendar; test-proven equal)

uncertainty.method: training moving-block bootstrap refits of both linear heads, complete date clusters; transformer refit each replicate
uncertainty.meaning: 90% sampling interval for fitted mean/probability; NOT individual return prediction interval
uncertainty.residual: past matured out-of-fold RMS of LINEAR relative-return residuals per fold; DISCLOSED as predictive dispersion for a future portfolio layer; never part of the opportunity decision
uncertainty.implementation: alpha_opportunity_v2_model.prediction_uncertainty: identical statistic to v1 (same seed, blocks, cluster weights, quantiles) from precomputed date indices; probability head refit on the NET label

tradabilityGuard.rule: PIT universe member on the signal date AND a positive finite sealed close AND positive finite sealed share volume on every one of the 20 regional exchange sessions ending on the signal date (calendar reindex, no fills)
tradabilityGuard.windowProvenance: v1's sealed 20-session ADV window, with the unsealed cash-value requirement replaced by traded-at-all evidence
tradabilityGuard.volumeUse: share volume as traded/not-traded evidence only; never multiplied by the forward total-return Close into a fictitious cash ADV
tradabilityGuard.universeFloor: US strictly-earlier S&P 500 constituent observation; KR strictly-earlier KRX top-120 by market cap
tradabilityGuard.advRequiredForExecutionRealism: only for a future portfolio layer sizing beyond the small-capital assumption
tradabilityGuard.notAlphaInput: tradability is a filter, never a feature or a score; liquidity as predictive information would be a separate registered feature and is not one here

carriedFromV2.transactionCostRule: repository benchmark_alpha.REALISTIC_COSTS via portfolio_validation._dated_cost_policy; roundtrip=(2*commissionBps+spreadBps+sellTaxBps)/10000 at signal date, public schedule known then; same ex-ante estimate charged in candidate diagnostics, not a realized portfolio cost simulation

inference.multiplicity: 98.75% two-sided intervals Bonferroni across four region x horizon primary claims; within claim all gates conjunctive
inference.resampling: noncircular moving blocks of complete chronological weekly date summaries; never iid names

carriedFromV2.note: no model, hyperparameter, feature or horizon changes; no feature was found PIT-unsafe on re-read; no DART ownership, Guru/13F or macro feature

evaluationPreregistration.A_absoluteCalibration: date-balanced pooled realised = a + b * predicted net relative return (not within-date demeaned); b lower > 0; a and b intervals published; MSE improvement over training mean lower > 0
evaluationPreregistration.B_ordering: equal-date rank IC lower > 0; within-date slope lower > 0
evaluationPreregistration.C_probability: Brier and log-loss improvement over training prevalence (net label) lower > 0; pooled date-balanced ECE upper <= 0.05 (v2 simulated null recorded in v2 spec)
evaluationPreregistration.D_positiveExpectedAlphaRegion: on dates with >= 1 POSITIVE_EXPECTED_ALPHA name: date-mean realised net relative return of those names lower > 0 (the outside-option test) AND same-date spread over non-positive names lower > 0 (lesser of level and spread); plus, disclosed not gated, realised-on-predicted slope inside the positive region and realised means by within-date terciles of predicted expectedNetAlpha among positive names (terciles fixed from predictions alone); no predicted-alpha threshold other than 0 is ever evaluated
evaluationPreregistration.D_disclosedBesideNotGating: D recomputed separately for EXPECTATION_POSITIVE_OUTPERFORM_PROBABILITY_NOT_ABOVE_HALF and FITTED_INTERVAL_SPANS_OUTSIDE_OPTION subsets, descriptive only
evaluationPreregistration.E_stability: annual folds >= 70% jointly positive (rank IC, Brier, MSE); D point estimate positive in each chronological half; regions separate, never pooled; no other subgroup
evaluationPreregistration.dependence: moving blocks of 26 whole weekly dates, 2000 draws, seed 42, 98.75% intervals over four region x horizon claims

rules: missingness that falls only on departed members is not random and cannot be tolerated as a share
a sample that never observes a security terminating contains no failed or acquired company
terminated names must carry the same total-return basis as survivors
a restricted window is admissible only if it is clean on the same rules in every year it covers; a smoothly declining share offers a tolerance, not a cutoff
endpoint stress acts on names in the sample and never repairs training survivorship
a departed symbol with no usable panel whose exit is not established by sealed evidence is an unresolved identity

identity.evidence: research_specs/alpha-opportunity-model-v3-us-identity-evidence.json.gz (Symbol/name/CIK at every pinned upstream commit; reproduces the pinned member lists exactly)
joinBases: SAME_CIK (never co-listed; successor present at the exit snapshot)
IDENTICAL_NAME (at the exact exit snapshot, never co-listed)
identity.malformedRule: resolved to T only if T is absent where the key sits, present in both neighbouring snapshots, and named by the key; otherwise IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED
never: an acquired or delisted company priced from its acquirer
a reused ticker's later panel priced as the old member
a join without one of the three bases
